body:
## Problem

The #593 fold contract depends on a published PR branch's SHAs staying fixed within a run. `publish` still force-pushes with lease when a bundle is re-published (`template/src/pdca_harness/publish.py:312-319` on branch `fix/593-stack-mode-append-only-fold-real-base-prs`). If a folded bundle is re-published while a run is still going (e.g. by hand with `pdca publish <id>` in another terminal), its old commits stay on the line and the next fold merges the new branch on top: duplicate or conflicting content.

Nothing inside one `flow` run does this today, and a new run restarts the line, so the round-1 code review raised it as a note only. The single-step `pdca publish` takes no drive claim (#573), so nothing stops it.

## Done when

Either `pdca publish` refuses a bundle whose branch is already on a live run's integration line (e.g. via the #573 claim), or the fold detects that a carried branch was rewritten (its recorded head is no longer an ancestor of the branch) and stops with a clear message. A test pins it.

Found by the eduralph/pdca-pdca Act review of 2026-10-02 (issue_593 iteration-v1 code review). Relates to #573.
title: stack mode: re-publishing a folded bundle during a live run leaves its old commits on the line
